name: Trepo
long_description:
Trepo is building agents that shop for you, starting with groceries.

To know what your household needs, a shopper has to understand what happens at home. Today, that information is scattered across cupboards, receipts, recipes, and the people living there, leaving one person to remember what’s running low, what needs using, and what’s for dinner.

Our Kitchen Assistant and connected app help households track their food, decide what to cook, and use what they already have. A shared device lives in the kitchen, where groceries are unpacked, meals are prepared, and leftovers are saved. That makes it easy to keep Trepo informed as those things happen, giving our agents the context to understand what your household needs and buy it for you.

We’re starting with food. Our ambition is a home that knows what it has, what it needs, and what to do next.
one_liner: The agentic grocery shopper that knows what you have and need.

launches.title: Trepo: The agentic grocery shopper that knows what you have and need.
launches.tagline: Trepo is building agents that shop for you, starting with groceries.
launches.body:
**A shopper can’t know what you need without knowing what you already have and use.**

Today, that knowledge is scattered across cupboards, receipts, recipes, and family preferences. Someone has to piece it together, remember what’s running low, and figure out what’s for dinner. Too often, one person carries that work for everyone.

Trepo’s Kitchen Assistant and connected app help households know what they have, find meals using those ingredients, and remember food that needs using soon. The device lives on the fridge or countertop, where groceries are unpacked and meals are made. Households can update their kitchen by voice or photo and follow recipes on its screen without juggling a phone. Those everyday interactions give Trepo’s shopper the context to buy what a household needs. 

We’re starting with food. Our ambition is a home that knows what it has, what it needs, and what to do next.

<https://youtu.be/n8ABb6cTb1I>

**The team**

* **Matt Taylor (CEO):** Previously Sr. Electronic Design Engineer at Tesla (Cybercab, Cybertruck, Model Y revamp) and Hardware Engineer at Nuro building autonomous delivery vehicles. MS and BS in Electrical Engineering from George Washington University.
* **Zach Slaughter (Co-founder):** Previously VP of Marketing & Brand at USCAPE Apparel. Started in advertising operations at Viant Technology. BA from George Washington University.
